artworks.title: Le Pruth
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a giant figure pouring water from a jug labeled "PRUTH" with people across from him. The image shows a giant figure sitting with a large jug labeled "PRUTH" from which water flows. Soldiers with rifles are visible in the background looking towards the giant figure. The soldiers wear uniforms and helmets. The drawing is detailed with expressive line work providing texture and depth to the scene. It is situated in a border with text below.

artworks.title: Les deux grands ducs ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds observing a distant battle. The drawing showcases two large birds standing on a rocky outcrop and looking down upon a chaotic battlefield below. The landscape is depicted with sweeping pencil strokes, illustrating both the rough terrain and the tumult of the battle, with numerous tiny figures scattered across the scene. The overall composition conveys a sense of observation and commentary on the events unfolding, using the birds as possible symbolic figures.

artworks.title: Arrivée en Alsace du commissaire ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person in profile, standing on a cart. The person is depicted in a dramatic pose, wearing an elaborate coat and pants typical of 19th-century fashion. They hold a scroll labeled "L'ERE DES CESARS." Surrounding them are various figures and creatures, such as butterflies and people in vibrant animated expressions. The scene suggests a dynamic environment, with a podium featuring a flame in the background. The cart has high wheels and decorative elements, enhancing the theatrical composition.

artworks.title: Voyons, genéral ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballroom scene with a skeletal figure and a man in uniform. The scene captures a lively ballroom atmosphere with couples dancing. In the foreground, there is a figure dressed as a skeleton playfully interacting with a man in a military uniform. The man in the uniform stands with his back to the viewer, arms crossed, observing the scene. Surrounding them are elegantly dressed couples dancing. The use of dark lines and shading gives the image a dramatic quality. The text at the bottom suggests a humorous or satirical context to the illustration.

artworks.title: La descente de la courtille en 1855
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures, including an animal and an anthropomorphic character. In the scene, there is a seated figure in profile wearing a top hat and coat, next to another figure in elaborate attire with a detailed hat featuring bird-like embellishments. A bear is standing to the right, leaning on a railing or ledge. In the background, a city or urban setting is depicted, with faint outlines of structures and multiple smaller figures engaged in various activities. The drawing features dynamic lines and shading, creating a lively atmosphere. Overall, the composition blends human and animal forms to represent an event titled 'la descente de la courtelle en 1855'.

artworks.title: Sur le point de se noyer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating a bear-like figure in distress, surrounded by water and raising its paws. The bear is facing a seated figure smoking a pipe, labeled "PRUSSE," who appears indifferent. The seated figure is adorned in robes with a crown on its head, conveying authority or nationhood. The image likely carries political satire, commenting on current events.

artworks.title: Saint Mitophan et le dieu mars ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of two figures seated on clouds. One figure is wearing a simple robe and the other is wearing a helmet with a plume. The drawing is in black and white, with detailed lines showing textures and swirling clouds. Shading adds depth, and the stylized proportions give a whimsical effect. The scene has a contemplative atmosphere with a hint of mythology.

artworks.title: L'ogre et le petit poucet
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large seated figure facing a much smaller figure holding a knife. The scene shows a heavyset, ogre-like character sitting against a tree with a slightly slumped posture. The larger figure is wearing military-like attire with exaggerated features. The smaller figure is standing in front, holding a knife at arm's length. They are dressed in soldier clothes, including a cap with a feather. The illustration is in black and white with heavy cross-hatching and shading for depth. The composition suggests a tense encounter between the figures, exploring themes of power dynamics and individuality.

artworks.title: Toujours la comète
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing woman to the left and a seated man to the right. The woman is wearing a long dress with a checkered pattern and an apron. She has short hair and is looking at the man. The man is seated in a chair at an angle, facing the woman. He has short hair and is wearing a jacket with a patterned texture. He is holding a newspaper and has his legs crossed. The background shows a domestic setting with a fireplace or mantel, softly lit with subtle details.

artworks.title: Plus que ca d'ballon ... Excusez! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person in a voluminous dress being watched by figures in top hats. The scene depicts an exaggeratedly large skirt occupying much of the visual space. The skirt is detailed with layered ruffles, and the figures in the background are depicted in muted tones with prominent top hats. The drawing is done in a style typical of 19th-century satire, capturing the social scenes and trends of that era with a humorous undertone.

artworks.title: Le 14 Juin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up, sitting up in bed. The person on the left is an older man with a long, pointed nose and pronounced chin. He has shaggy hair and wears a nightcap that flops over to one side. The second person, on the right, is an older woman with a softer facial structure, full cheeks, and kind eyes. She has a cap covering her hair. Both individuals are wearing loose nightclothes. The man’s hands are clasped together on his lap, while the woman has one hand resting on the bed. The background consists of heavily shaded drapery.

artworks.title: Venant de donner le dernier coup de pinceau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure painting in an art gallery or studio. The figure is elevated, holding a brush and a palette, surrounded by framed artworks. The background shows more framed paintings.

artworks.title: Vue prise a la buvette pendant la canicule
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four people from the waist up, drinking from mugs with exaggerated caricature features. They are depicted in the act of drinking. The central figure is a man in a suit, wearing a tall hat and the woman beside him wears a decorated dress. There is another figure with a smaller head wearing a top hat, and a slightly older man in the back row. The background depicts a crowded indoor setting, with faint outlines of people and decorations. To the left, there are outlines of bottles and glasses on a counter.

artworks.title: Nouveau système de pendule ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts several men from the waist up. The central figure has a broad face, a prominent nose, round eyes, and curly hair under a tall, black top hat. He is dressed in a dark cloak over a shirt with a bow tie. In front of him stands a boy with wide eyes wearing a flat-brimmed hat. To the left, another man holds a pocket watch, looking closely at it. Another taller man with a raised handkerchief stands beside him. In the background, there are various clock faces on a wall, creating a crowded setting that may represent an exhibition or shop.

artworks.title: Nymphes des bords de la marene
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in various positions and angles. On the left stands a full-bodied figure partially submerged in water adjusting their garment sleeve. In the middle is a seated person in water with a worn expression. On the right, a standing person is visible from mid-calf up adjusting headwear or hair. All three individuals wear modest, loose-fitting clothing. The background features a lightly sketched scenic view of water and trees under a softly textured sky. The scene is in a monochrome, pencil-drawn style.

artworks.title: Monsieur Prudhomme ... Je me noie! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing in water. One figure appears distressed while the other appears nonchalant. The scene is at the beach or a body of water. The water is depicted with flowing lines. To the left, a smaller figure with a concerned expression is holding onto a rope, while the larger figure to the right is complacently leaning on another part of the same rope. The background features additional figures scattered across the water. The image uses simple lines and shading to convey texture and form.

artworks.title: Philosophes d'eau douce ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people leaning towards each other from separate boats. The entirety of their upper bodies is visible as they rest their arms on the edges of the boats, with the person on the left facing the one on the right. The person on the left has a round face with defined features and straight dark hair that falls around their face, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a loose, long-sleeved garment. The person on the right has a beard and mustache, with dark, short hair covered by a hat, and is dressed in a striped shirt with sleeves rolled up, revealing a muscular build. The background features a river landscape with blurred lines suggesting water movement, and a small structure on a hill in the distance, surrounded by sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Ayant éprouvé le besoin de se rafraichir avec ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an audience member in a theater watching a ballet performance. The foreground features a reclining figure appearing relaxed. In the background, two dancers stand on stage in dynamic poses. The theater interior is depicted with minimal detail, including an additional figure in an upper balcony. The monochrome illustration uses loose, expressive lines to convey motion and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Après vous ... s'il en reste! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure, a man, is depicted standing on the left side. He is holding a hat in one hand and has a rifle slung over his shoulder. The other figure is partially shown on all fours with only their upper body and head visible. The standing man has a cartoonish style with a round face, a prominent nose, and a furrowed brow. He has short unkempt hair and is dressed in a vest, shirt, and knee-length trousers. The figure on all fours wears a cloak and is accompanied by two dogs, one of which is sniffing the ground. The background is a sketched landscape with vague outlines of hills or rock formations in a barren setting.

artworks.title: Voila pourtant ce qu'on est convenu d'appeler ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two hunters and a dog walking together. The drawing shows the hunters walking side by side with a long-haired dog leading the way. Each hunter is dressed in traditional hunting attire, carrying long guns. The figures are in an outdoor setting, likely signifying a hunting expedition. The line work is detailed, capturing both the expressions and the texture of their clothing. The caption translates to "Here is what they agreed to call the strong emotions of hunting!" indicating an unexpected or lackluster feeling to the hunt.

artworks.title: Un dernier toast
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing on a table with one hand holding a bottle and the other hand raised with a glass. His facial features are exaggerated, with an open mouth. He has dark hair and is wearing a loose shirt and trousers. Four other individuals are seated at a table, displaying various facial expressions. They are dressed in hats and simple clothing. The background shows beams and columns, suggesting an interior setting.

artworks.title: Un des trois amis de la paix ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in theatrical attire interacting with a dog chewing on a sack. The person is wearing checkered clothing and a hat, using a cane or staff, and appears to be shouting or gesturing animatedly. The dog is energetically engaged with a large sack. Below the scene, text in French is visible. The drawing exhibits a style reminiscent of caricature or satirical illustration, focusing on exaggeration and expression.

artworks.title: Le boursicotières ... Voyons, ma chère ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figure walking together. The figures are humorously exaggerated, wearing full suits and top hats. One figure is rounder with a prominent, curving posture, while the other is leaner, striding forward purposefully. Both have exaggerated features and are depicted in a slightly abstract manner, emphasizing the comical nature of their attire and gestures. In the background, there are large architectural columns, and a group of smaller figures are gathered or watching the two leading figures. The illustration includes intricate line work defining shapes and shadows.

artworks.title: Les boursicotières. Me trouvez-vous bien ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing multiple people dressed in period attire, depicted from head to toe. In the foreground, a central figure with discernible facial features, including a large nose, is wearing a long coat, a top hat, and holding a cane. Next to this person, another individual is facing them, similarly dressed in formal attire and holding a piece of paper or notes. Other individuals in the background are also wearing formal attire. The scene is set against a backdrop suggesting classical architectural features such as columns. People in the background appear to be part of a bustling crowd engaging in various activities.
